name: Distressed Before It Sells: the full ranked list
description: 839 Minneapolis houses piling up city cases while the owner lives somewhere else, ranked, with the owner's mailing address, every case and the last sale. Refreshed weekly.
line: The full list of 839 houses, with each address, the owner's mailing address, every case, the last sale, the spreadsheet, and a fresh list every week, is $500, once.
